name: World Election
original_name: ワールド・エレクション
source:
World Election is the 10th anniversary game for Whirlpool.

The world was split up amongst 5 different factions, the dark world of hell, an advanced technical world, the peaceful land of God and Angels, the primitive beast world, and the human world.

As our story begins, it’s already been about 20 years since all of these worlds have been unified and are ruled in peace by the World Government. The protagonist is a type of person that people call a “Neo”, a human of the new generation who has been born with a special power. He currently attends an international school in the special region, but otherwise lives a very ordinary life.

One day a meteorite crashes down nearby, and a single girl appears out of the rubble. She says her name is Kururu and that she is the God of destruction, though the rest of her memory seems to be lost.
Her arrival happens just as the school is preparing for the new student council elections and due to circumstances our protagonist ends up running in them as well.

Other famous students follow his example and also nominate themselves as candidates in the elections, not to mention the dangerous ones as well. All of this marks the starts of the greatest student council elections in history, opening the door for a new chapter in the history of the world…

[From [url=http://www.otakulair.com/games/world-election/]Otaku Lair[/url]]
translation:
世界选举是Whirlpool的10周年纪念游戏。

世界分为五个不同的派系，黑暗的地狱世界、先进的科技世界、和平的神与天使之地、原始的兽世界和人类世界。

当我们的故事开始时，所有这些世界已经统一并由世界政府和平统治已经过去了大约20年。主角是一种被人们称为“Neo”的人，是天生就拥有特殊力量的新一代人类。他目前就读于特区的一所国际学校，但除此之外过着非常平凡的生活。

有一天，一颗陨石在附近坠落，一名女孩从废墟中出现。她说她的名字叫库鲁鲁，她是毁灭之神，但她的其余记忆似乎都丢失了。
她的到来恰逢学校正在为新一届学生会选举做准备，由于环境的原因，我们的主角最终也参加了选举。

其他名门弟子也效仿他的做法，提名自己为候选人参加选举，更不用说危险的了。这一切都标志着历史上最伟大的学生会选举的开始，为世界历史的新篇章打开了大门……

[来自[url=http://www.otakulair.com/games/world-election/]宅男巢穴[/url]]
